basic_profile.bio: A passionate music producer from Austin, Texas, who's been crafting electronic and rock fusion tracks for over a decade. I spend most nights in my home studio experimenting with synths and guitars. By day, I'm a sound engineer at a local music venue. I'm single and enjoy late-night Reddit scrolls, especially in threads about music production and survival games. I dislike mainstream pop music and always seek out the unique and experimental sounds. My online hours are generally late evenings to early mornings.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a degree in Audio Engineering and have been self-teaching music production since high school. My expertise lies in integrating electronic elements with traditional rock instruments, and I'm always keen to learn about new techniques in sound mixing and mastering.
